title: Senior Cloud Security Specialist
description:
About the Job A career within Cybersecurity and Privacy services at PwC offers the opportunity to help clients design and build secure cloud environments that drive innovation, enhance resilience, and deliver business value. As more organizations adopt cloud-native technologies, the need for robust, scalable, and secure cloud architectures is more important than ever. We are expanding our cybersecurity team in the Baltics and are looking for a technically skilled and motivated Cloud Security Specialist to join us. This role focuses on the hands-on design and delivery of cloud security solutions that safeguard cloud workloads, enforce best practices, and support secure digital transformation.

As a Cloud Security Specialist, you will design, implement, and operate security controls within complex cloud environments. You will work directly with clients to build and enhance secure architectures, support secure cloud adoption, and help define best practices in cloud-native security. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about cloud technology and cybersecurity and want to work on impactful local and international projects.

Job location: Vilnius, Riga or Tallinn

Main Responsibilities:


 * Design and implement cloud-native security controls and architectures in Azure or AWS environments.
 * Support configuration of secure cloud services including IAM, network security, logging/monitoring, data protection, and workload security.
 * Participate in hands-on cloud security engineering, such as policy enforcement using tools like Azure Policy, AWS Config, Security Hub, or cloud-native firewalls.
 * Collaborate with client DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security in infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines.
 * Assist in the development and documentation of cloud security reference architectures, blueprints, and operational runbooks.
 * Troubleshoot and support ongoing cloud security operations including incident response, vulnerability management, and hardening.
   
   

Requirements:


 * 3-5+ years of experience in cloud engineering or cybersecurity roles, with a strong focus on Azure and/or AWS.
 * Hands-on experience deploying and managing cloud-native security controls and tools.
 * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure components such as virtual networks, identity management, key management services, and logging pipelines.
 * Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation) and DevSecOps practices is an advantage.
 * Understanding of cloud-native threat models and security architecture principles.
 * Relevant certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, Azure Cybersecurity Architect, or equivalent are preferred.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; fluent English required.
   
   

We offer:


 * A monthly gross salary ranging from EUR 3000 to EUR 6000 EUR.
 * A personalized development plan for your professional growth and an experienced mentor by your side;
 * Annual salary review, bonus program, additional annual vacation days and leave days for significant life events;
 * Great office location in the city center, equipped with everything you need for a small break at work and fresh snacks at all times
 * Attractive benefits package after the probation period (health insurance, 3rd pension pillar, budget for dining or sports/health services);
 * Opportunity to work partially remotely (hybrid model);
 * Regular company events, including team-building activities and wellness initiatives.
   
   

Time to start: Autumn 2025

Once you have submitted your application, our PwC HR specialists will thoroughly assess your candidacy. Should your experience, knowledge, and education align with our requirements, we will gladly invite you via email to complete a test. Regardless of the outcome, we will keep you informed about the status of your application.

title: Priviliģētās piekļuves pārvaldības vadītājs / -ja (PAM Lead)
description:
Pievienojies mūsu komandai kā [X]!

Jā, Tu to vari! Tāda ir mūsu nostāja pret darbu, ambīcijām, idejām un attiecībām. Mēs Luminor ticam, ka ikvienam ir potenciāls sasniegt lielus mērķus, un mudinām ikvienu tos īstenot – gan profesionālajā, gan personīgajā dzīvē.

Lai kas Tu būtu un kāda būtu Tava loma, Luminor Tev sniegs unikālu iespēju kļūt par banku nozares čempionu.

Mēs meklējam augsti kvalificētu un pieredzējušu Priviliģētās piekļuves pārvaldības (PAM) vadītājs/ ja, kurš uzraudzīs priviliģētās piekļuves kontroles izstrādi, ieviešanu un pārvaldību visā uzņēmumā. Šī loma ir būtiska sensitīvu sistēmu un datu aizsardzībā, nodrošinot, ka priviliģētie konti tiek pienācīgi pārvaldīti, uzraudzīti un aizsargāti.

Mēs Tev uzticēsim:


 * Izstrādāt un uzturēt PAM stratēģiju, ceļvedi un politikas, kas atbilst drošības un atbilstības prasībām.
 * Vadīt PAM pārvaldības iniciatīvas, tostarp periodiskas piekļuves pārbaudes, auditus un atskaites.
 * Pārvaldīt PAM rīku (piemēram, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea u.c.) izvietošanu un konfigurēšanu.
 * Uzraudzīt priviliģēto kontu un sistēmu integrēšanu PAM risinājumā.
 * Nodrošināt pareizu kontu glabāšanu, sesiju uzraudzību un akreditācijas datu rotāciju.
 * Ieviest PAM prakses un/vai kontroles mūsdienīgā mākoņvides darba vidē (AWS/Azure).
 * Sadarboties ar iekšējā audita, riska un atbilstības komandām, lai nodrošinātu, ka PAM kontroles atbilst normatīvajiem standartiem (piemēram, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
 * Reaģēt uz audita konstatējumiem un īstenot koriģējošus pasākumus.
 * Vadīt PAM inženieru un analītiķu komandu, sniedzot tehnisko vadību un mentoringu.
 * Cieši sadarboties ar IT, infrastruktūras un lietojumprogrammu komandām, lai integrētu PAM kontroles dažādās platformās.
 * Uzraudzīt priviliģētās piekļuves aktivitātes un izmeklēt anomālijas vai iespējamu ļaunprātīgu izmantošanu.
 * Atbalstīt reaģēšanas uz incidentiem pasākumus, kas saistīti ar priviliģēto kontu apdraudējumu.
   
   

Tu iederēsies mūsu komandā, ja Tev ir:


 * Bakalaura grāds datorzinātnēs, informācijas drošībā vai līdzīgā jomā.
 * Vairāk nekā 5 gadu pieredze identitātes un piekļuves pārvaldībā, no kuriem vismaz 2 gadi PAM vadībā.
 * Praktiska pieredze ar PAM rīkiem, piemēram, CyberArk, BeyondTrust vai līdzīgiem.
 * Spēcīga izpratne par Active Directory, Windows/Linux sistēmām, mākoņplatformām (AWS, Azure) un tīklu infrastruktūru.
 * Zināšanas par normatīvajiem regulējumiem un standartiem (piemēram, GDPR, PCI-DSS, SWIFT, DORA, NIS2).
 * Teicamas komunikācijas, līderības un sadarbības prasmes ar iesaistītajām pusēm.
 * Darba pienākumos ir paredzēts komunicēt ar kolēģiem no visām Baltijas valstīm, tāpēc šajā lomā kandidātam ir nepieciešamas teicamas angļu valodas zināšanas gan mutiski, gan rakstiski
   
   

Vēlamās prasmes un kvalifikācija:


 * Atbilstoši sertifikāti (piemēram, CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, CISSP, CISM, CISA).
 * Pieredze ar automatizāciju un skriptu izstrādi (PowerShell, Python).
 * Zināšanas par "Zero Trust" un minimālās piekļuves principiem.
   
   

Mēs Tev piedāvājam:


 * Atalgojums no 3,510 - 6,470 EUR bruto, kā arī iespēja pretendēt uz atalgojuma pārskatu reizi gadā.
 * Elastīga darba vide. Elastīgs darba laiks, attālināts darbs un iespēja strādāt no jebkuras vietas ES, Islandē, Šveicē un Apvienotajā Karalistē (kopā 90 dienas gadā).
 * Starptautiskas komandas. Komandas, kas iziet ārpus Baltijas robežām, kur cilvēki novērtē izaicinājumu bagātu darbu kopā ar labu humoru un prieku.
 * Vairāk atvaļinājuma. Papildu nedēļas atvaļinājums pieejams visiem darbiniekiem, kuri ir uzņēmumā strādājuši 1 gadu vai ilgāk.
 * Brīvprātīgo atvaļinājums. Mums rūp dot savu ieguldījumu sabiedrībai, tāpēc jūs saņemsiet papildu brīvdienas brīvprātīgas darbības nolūkos.
 * Apmaksāts atvaļinājums. Mēs lepojamies ar savu darbiniekiem, kuri piedalās militārajās apmācībās. Tāpēc Luminor katru gadu piedāvā 30 pilnībā apmaksātas dienas militārajām apmācībām.
 * Veselības apdrošināšana. Konkurētspējīgs labumu grozs papildus jūsu algai, kas ietver veselības apdrošināšanu visās trīs Baltijas valstīs, kā arī veselības dienas, ja jums ir neplānota prombūtne slimības dēļ bez ārsta paziņojuma.
 * Labklājība. Piekļuve rīkiem un resursiem, kas palīdz justies labi un būt produktīvam gan darbā, gan privātajā dzīvē.
 * Profesionālā izaugsme. Iekšējās un ārējās apmācību programmas, darbnīcas, konferences, tiešsaistes apmācības utt.
   
   

Tā kā mūsu organizācijas saziņas pamatvaloda ir angļu valoda, sagaidi, ka ar Tevi sazināsies un intervija notiks angļu valodā, kā arī darbā pieņemšanas process arī notiks angļu valodā.

Piesakies līdz 2. oktobrim!

Ja vēlies pieteikties, lūdzu, negaidi līdz pēdējai dienai — mēs varam turpināt atlasi ar piemērotiem kandidātiem arī pirms pieteikšanās termiņa beigām.

Lūdzu, pieteikties ar savu CV angļu vai latviešu valodā un PDF formātā.

title: PAM Lead
description:
Join our team as a PAM Lead!

Yes, you can! That's our attitude towards our work, ambitions, ideas and relationships. We, at Luminor, believe that anyone has the potential to achieve big things and encourage everyone to achieve them – professionally and personally.

Whoever you are, and whatever your role is, with Luminor you will get a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to build a local banking champion.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Privileged Access Management (PAM) Lead to oversee the design, implementation, and governance of privileged access controls across our enterprise. This role is critical in protecting sensitive systems and data by ensuring that privileged accounts are properly managed, monitored, and secured.

What You Will Do:

Strategy & Governance



 * Develop and maintain the PAM strategy, roadmap, and policies aligned with security and compliance requirements.
 * Lead PAM governance initiatives, including periodic access reviews, audits, and reporting.
   
   
   

Implementation & Operations



 * Manage the deployment and configuration of PAM tools (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, etc.).
 * Oversee onboarding of privileged accounts and systems into the PAM solution.
 * Ensure proper vaulting, session monitoring, and credential rotation for privileged accounts.
 * Implementation of PAM practices and/or controls in modern working cloud environments (AWS/Azure).
   
   
   

Risk Management & Compliance



 * Collaborate with internal audit, risk, and compliance teams to ensure PAM controls meet regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
 * Respond to audit findings and implement remediation plans.
   
   
   

Team Leadership & Collaboration



 * Lead a team of PAM engineers and analysts, providing technical guidance and mentorship.
 * Work closely with IT, infrastructure, and application teams to integrate PAM controls across platforms.
   
   
   

Monitoring & Incident Response



 * Monitor privileged access activities and investigate anomalies or potential misuse.
 * Support incident response efforts related to privileged account compromise.
   
   
   

What We Expect:



 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
 * 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, with at least 2 years in PAM leadership.
 * Hands-on experience with PAM tools such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or similar.
 * Strong understanding of Active Directory, Windows/Linux systems, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), and networking.

title: Security Test Engineer/Penetration Tester
description:
SECURITY TEST ENGINEER/PENETRATION TESTER

If digital transformation, next-generation technology, and growth opportunities excite you, then join our Netcracker Technology team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams, earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations around the world.




What’s in it for You?

At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.




Requirements For Candidates

We are looking for experienced penetration testing specialists to join our application security team. The primary focus will be on regular security assessments of Netcracker product suite and customer solutions (self-service portals, CRM, rating and billing systems, cloud deployments). The role offers potential for growth both in technical domain and professionally.




What We Are Looking For

 * 2+ years of experience as a penetration tester
 * Proven abilities to approach a black box and white box testing
 * Deep knowledge of OWASP top-10 vulnerabilities and attacks
 * Perfect knowledge of OWASP methodology and web vulnerabilities – you can easily explain what it is and show how it works
 * Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanners (static and dynamic) and frameworks, including but not limited to, OWASP ZAP, Burp, Nmap, Metasploit Framework and code scanners like CheckMarx SCA, Xray, CheckMarx
 * Hands-on experience with API penetration testing of Rest/SOAP based interfaces
 * Comfortable working with Microsoft Windows, MS Office, Linux, WSL, and CLI tools
 * Strong analytical skills
 * Higher degree in IT, Telecommunications or related areas (Preferably a Master's Degree)




Job Description

 * Discovering all information on system and solution exploitability (of Top 10 vulnerabilities categorized by OWASP, CWE/CVE like XSS, CSRF, SSRF, SQLi, RCE, XXE and uncommon HTTP Request Smuggling/Splitting, other) and security weaknesses from a variety of sources (technical documentation, source code, communication with project and development teams)
 * Assessing of application and solution security controls against «black box», «grey box» and «white box» attacks using both manual and automated (DAST) penetration testing techniques
 * Source code static analysis (client/server/database) for vulnerabilities with scanning tools - SAST
 * Analysis and evaluation of 3rd party vulnerabilities as part of product implementation processes
 * Prioritization of identified vulnerabilities accordingly to CVSS v.3.1 / v.4.0
 * Assessment of findings with development teams, analysis, preparation and evaluation of mitigation options, resolution
 * Analysis and evaluation of customer reports and 3rd party penetration test results
 * Planning and tracking progress for assigned tasks
 * Working in international team of professionals




What We Offer

 * Gross salary from € 2000 up to € 3500 depending on the level of your skills
 * Medical insurance
 * More than 300 hard and soft-skills programs by the corporate career development center
 * Open work environment and encouraging knowledge sharing culture
 * Possibility to work in a hybrid work-mode

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:

title: Security Engineer
description:

Location: Riga, Latvia

 * Partner with product and engineering teams to embed security throughout the SDLC.
 * Conduct code reviews with a focus on secure coding practices.
 * Support security tools for vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST.
   
   

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

title: Senior Penetration Tester / Adversary Simulation Specialist
description:
A career within Cybersecurity and Privacy services at PwC offers the opportunity to work on the frontlines of digital defense, helping clients identify vulnerabilities before adversaries do. As cyber threats become more sophisticated, adversary simulation and offensive security are essential to building resilient organizations. We are growing our cybersecurity capabilities in the Baltics and are seeking a technically skilled and motivated Penetration Tester / Adversary Simulation Specialist to join our team. This role focuses on delivering offensive security engagements, both for local clients and in collaboration with PwC teams across the broader Central and Eastern Europe region. As a Penetration Tester / Adversary Simulation Specialist, you will lead and support offensive security engagements including infrastructure, web application, and cloud penetration testing, as well as red and purple teaming initiatives. You will simulate real-world attack scenarios, identify exploitable weaknesses, and provide actionable guidance to clients seeking to strengthen their defenses. Job location: Vilnius, Riga or Tallinn.

Main Responsibilities:


 * Conduct infrastructure, application, and cloud penetration tests using industry-standard tools and custom scripts.
 * Simulate advanced attack scenarios through red team or assumed breach exercises.
 * Develop and deliver clear, technically accurate findings and remediation guidance to both technical and executive stakeholders.
 * Collaborate with incident response, cloud security, and digital identity teams to integrate offensive insights into broader cyber programs.
 * Stay current on threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and continuously evolve testing approaches.
 * Contribute to development of internal toolkits, testing procedures, and service documentation.
   
   

Requirements:


 * 3+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing or offensive security roles.
 * Proficiency in using tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, and scripting languages like Python or PowerShell.
 * Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and red/purple team methodologies.
 * Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CRTP, OSCE, or similar are highly desirable.
 * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; fluent English required.
   
   

We offer:

 * Annual salary review, bonus program, additional annual vacation days and leave days for significant life events;
 * Great office location in the city center, equipped with everything you need for a small break at work and fresh snacks at all times
 * Attractive benefits package after the probation period (health insurance, 3rd pension pillar, budget for dining or sports/health services);
 * Opportunity to work partially remotely (hybrid model);
 * Regular company events, including team-building activities and wellness initiatives.
   
   

Time to start: Autumn 2025

Regardless of the outcome, we will keep you informed about the status of your application.
